item.title: Libre Barcode Project
item.description:
📝 Libre Barcode Project Libre Barcode fonts enable you to write barcodes in the Code 39, Code 128, and EAN/UPC formats, with or without text below the code. Code 128 Encoder Enter a text: If it can be encoded with Code 128 you will see a scannable barcode, rendered with the Libre Barcode 128 Text font. Copy the encoded text to use it with one of the Libre Barcode 128 fonts:.
